name: Supine Arms in Straps — Pull Down
stable: Pelvis, spine and legs in tabletop
summary: Lying on the back with legs in tabletop and hands in the straps, straight arms press from above the chest down to the carriage beside the hips.
steps: Lie on the back, shoulders against the shoulder rests, legs lifted to tabletop.
Hands in the short loops, arms straight up just in front of the shoulders.
Breathe out to press the arms down to the carriage by the hips.
Breathe in to lift them back up.

layers.title: Add a leg reach
layers.text: One or both legs extend as the arms press.

layers.title: Prop
layers.text: Ball or ring between the knees or ankles.

modifications: Feet down on the footbar if the back arches.

cautions.note: Lying flat on the back: keep it to a few minutes, raise the head end if you can, and stop if she feels dizzy.

cues:
Knees stay over the hips.
No arching — the back of the ribs stays heavy.
Arms long with soft elbows.
Stop the arms just short of vertical so the straps stay loaded.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
